notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:
Fixes:
[list]
    [*]UI sounds not playing
    [*]Line renderer not playing animation
    [*]Re-captured magnets in Level 50 that tried to escape 
[/list]

We have also found a problem with Linux 32bit where our steam integration was not working. This have been submitted and being worked on but in the meantime a 64bit Linux version has been released.

notes.title: Release Delayed until 7th August
notes.content:
Due to the discovery of a number of issues, we've decided to delay the release of Flux8 until 7th August. This is to ensure that the game functions as expected on all platforms. It also gives us extra time to polish the level editor and make sure it is as user-friendly as possible. 

We apologize for the delay.
Canalside Studios
